description: List free marketplace GPUs with VRAM, region, count, and CAD hourly rate, plus capacity counts for online hosts and total, available, allocated, held, and unavailable GPUs. Use when the user asks what hardware is available, whether nodes are online, or why nothing is free. The gpus array contains only free GPUs; an empty array does not mean nodes are offline. Check capacity and the inventory breakdown by model and region. For the caller's running jobs, use list_instances with status running. Read-only and free. Counts use the placement snapshot and fresh worker observations; inventory changes continuously.
name: list_available_gpus
